goal.rationale: Top-right corridor exit forces every agent to traverse at least one single-tile bridge before arrival.

a1.rationale: Bottom-left corner feeds directly into the lower bridge queue.

a2.rationale: Left approach halfway up, often contests the lower bridge with a1/a4.

a3.rationale: Upper-left scout must clear the top bridge and warn others.

a4.rationale: Bottom-right entrant headed west, collides with left team at lower bridge.

a5.rationale: Mid-right agent pushing north-to-south through the upper bridge, forcing alternating yields.
